assets.alt: A block of mass M on a rough horizontal floor with coefficient μ, pushed by a force F acting downward at angle θ to the horizontal on its top right corner.
A block M at rest on a floor pushed down and to the left by F at θ below the horizontal; friction f = F cos θ to the left. Note: at rest, static friction equals what is needed.
